meta.cadence: At least one substantive, falsifiable THI research note per calendar month during active CFB/CBB seasons.
meta.standard: Each published note must state its question, sample, method, uncertainty, result, limitations, and whether the finding changed production.

notes.title: Prospective Forecast Calibration and Market Translation
notes.question: How accurately are THI forecasts calibrated, and where has forecast quality translated—or failed to translate—to the market?
notes.method: Frozen prospective forecasts, 95% Wilson intervals for binary rates, and fixed-seed bootstrap intervals for continuous error and CLV metrics.
notes.result: Published without suppressing weak tiers; predictive accuracy and market translation remain separate.
notes.limitations: Young samples, incomplete historical CBB freeze timestamps, and variable market-source coverage.
notes.production_effect: None. Audit and presentation release only.
